english:
Hey, Gin.
Collecting Gin Tama too? Then don't be picky at first. Pick up any Gin Tama you find.
What matters is building up
your supply. With too few Gin Tama,
you'll be at a huge disadvantage
in battle...

Nah, I'm a lost cause... I had a pretty good collection,
but I'm hopeless at
Gin Tama battles. They took nearly all of mine.
Ha ha ha... What'll I do for spending money
this month...?

Pick up any Gin Tama you find.
First, build up your supply. With too few Gin Tama,
you'll be at a huge disadvantage
in battle...
This is [blue]Yorozuya Street[/color], right?\fI heard you can find Gin Tama\naround here...\fDid someone beat me to them?
You can find quite a few Gin Tama\nin the shadows along the streets\nand around buildings.\fWho's hiding them all, anyway?
You can find quite a few Gin Tama\nin the shadows along the streets\nand around buildings.
There's roadwork everywhere\nlately...\fI suppose we'll be able to pass\nonce they're done...\fI wish they'd hurry up.
Sigh. Gin Tama again.\fNo one at the beach.\fSome beach samurai I am.\fRiver samurai, then?\fThat won't help.
translator_note: Beach Samurai conversation, condensed to the original five-page fixed slot. Source reading checked locally; retain the river-samurai joke.

english: Heavenly, Kondo!\fKatsudon! A whole tube of mayo! Perfection!
translator_note: Hasegawa encounter or Hijikata Special shop exchange.

english: Hijikata Special? Is it tasty?
Instant heartburn...
Another mayo victim...
Call yourself a yakuza?!\nCall that a punch perm?!\fA yakuza's gotta\nbe LOUD, you idiot!
Shinsengumi?!\nCan't rock a punch perm\nif you're scared of them!
Boss, wigs are amazing\nthese days!\nYou can't even tell!
Uh, boss...\nYou're the louder one...
Sorry...\nOn the boss's behalf...\nWill this make up for it?
He may not look it,\nbut our boss is a coward.\nPlease go easy on him.
I can hear you.\nI'm just not listening.
I know what you'll say.\fPay me! Or at least\nfeed me! Such\ncrass demands...
TV? What are you\nso busy watching?
It's not Ladies 4, either.
Model answer?

So the news will
find us work?
You're sure? No work, Shinichi?
It's on you.
What's on? Theft?\nFraud? Murder?
Ladies don't eat\npickled kelp.
What, Shinpachi?\nYou look like\nyou've seen death.
You're captain. Not me.
You forge your own fate.\fAnd what kind of\nlousy fate is that?!
Still no.\fCollect them yourself.
Who'd want them?!
I'm watching the news.\fKeeping up with events\nto find us some work.\fBasic marketing.\nBasic!
All the rage in Edo now!\fEven a freeloader like Sakata knows!
translator_note: Otose opening and field introduction before Shinpachi.

english: Yes, Dragon Tama. You need seven, I think...\fGather them and pray. Any wish comes true...
But, Otose, someone won the lottery after collecting seven...
I know! Don't mock me, perm-head!\fA friend's relative's neighbour's son's teacher's ex-wife told me.\fSo it's probably true.
A landlady's like a mother. Tenants are her kids.\fYour poor child's crying from hunger!
What?! Really?!\fThey actually won the lottery?!
Those who believe shall be saved!\fNonbelievers get nothing but death in a ditch.\fHelp me! Once I'm rich... I'll buy you pickled kelp!
Fair point.
It's a hoax. An urban legend.\fOnly idiots and desperate poor people believe it.
Gin-chan! Granny's blinded by greed! We can get a free lesson!
No food for freeloaders!
Even a clueless guy like you knows Gin Tama?
...\fLooking awfully sure of yourself.\fIs my explanation just meddling?
Some customers...\fThey bring their orbs and trade.\fBesides ordinary orbs, there are valuable rare ones.
You're fired up!\fBut you're a Gin Tama battle beginner.\fGo in knowing nothing and get flattened.\fSince you're motivated, and I need rent... I'll teach you the basics.

Not bad at all.\fThe local crowd shouldn't give you trouble.\fNot that you'd lose a war of words...\fBut you need Gin Tama. Keep collecting!\fThere are rare orbs even I haven't seen.\fI've heard...\fKotodama Boost powers up Kotodama.\fCharacter Orbs can summon allies.\fI'd love to try those myself.\fAnyway, relax and enjoy yourself.\fNow get out there and pay your rent!

What a sorry showing.\fThe orbs I lent you weren't great, either. Beginners, eh?\fCollect more orbs. Get some practice.\fYou may find a rare orb you never expected.\fI've heard...\fKotodama Boost powers up Kotodama.\fCharacter Orbs can summon allies.\fI'd love to try those myself.\fAnyway, relax and enjoy yourself.\fNow get out there and pay your rent!
Got any real Gin Tama?
translator_note: Catherine asks Sakata whether he has genuine Gin Tama. Shortened to fit the original message slot.

english: How will you fight, then?
Carefree mayor?\fHere take this.
Lost item.
No slander!\fFound it, not stolen.
Who said it was free, you blockhead?
I know.\fIf rare orbs make you rich, I want my cut!
Forget back rent! I'll pay ten years in advance!
Come on, Kagura! No time to waste!
No. I'll get some.
Yeah figures.
Huh?\fThis Gin Tama's for me?
Sticky fingers.
No Gin Tama? Tough.\fThanks, I'll take it.
I've got no money.
Fine! If I get rich, I'll treat you to plain udon!\fWe're off, Granny! Catherine!
No way! I've never seen that broadcast!
Look forward to rent and plain udon!
With that cash, we'd be better off buying our own building.
Gin-chan! Don't question it! Just play along...
Honestly... First time in a video game?
Old saying...\fLess worry, more action.
That joke's been done to death!
Huh?
Shinpachi! Help me out!
translator_note: Gintoki asks Shinpachi to help. Source checked locally; fixed-slot wording.

english: Then help!\fI'm after Gin Tama!
translator_note: Gintoki is collecting Gin Tama too. Source checked locally; original two-page structure preserved.

english: So, I need those rare Dragon Tama!
translator_note: Gintoki explains why he needs rare Dragon Tama. Dragon Tama is a provisional rendering distinct from Gin Tama; source checked locally.

english: Want to get rich?\fYou a saint now?\fNo dreams? No romance? Some man you are!
translator_note: Gintoki mocks Shinpachi for refusing riches and adventure. Three original pages retained; fixed-slot wording.

english: Are you nuts?!
translator_note: Gintoki objects to Shinpachi competing with him. Source checked locally.

english: You sappy, starstruck four-eyes!
translator_note: Gintoki mocks Shinpachi as a dreamy, celebrity-obsessed glasses wearer. Fixed-slot wording.

english: I play nice, you get cocky!
translator_note: Shinpachi encounter and duel setup.

english: Then let's duel!\fGin Tama style!
Gin Tama duel!\fI win: help me. You win: go.\fNo grudges.
Let's go!
Gin-chan... How will you find those orbs?
Less curry? More spuds?
Gin-chan! Look...!
It's Shinpachi!
Man up! Got balls, Shinpachi?
translator_note: Kagura joins the taunting. Retains the original ball joke; condensed to the fixed slot.

english: That age.
translator_note: Kagura dryly remarks that Shinpachi is at that age. Condensed to the tiny fixed slot.

english: You too.
Huh? Gin? Kagura? What's up?
translator_note: Shinpachi meets Gintoki and Kagura. Source checked locally; wording shortened to the original fixed slot.

english: Help? I can't. I'm hunting Gin Tama!\fLook, I got a few!
translator_note: Shinpachi refuses because he is collecting Gin Tama, then shows what he found. Source checked locally; both pages retained.

english: Huh?!
translator_note: Shinpachi reacts with surprise. Source checked locally.

english: That's your problem!\fAnyway, no. I won't help!
translator_note: Shinpachi refuses to help Gintoki. Condensed to the fixed slot; both original pages kept.

english: Then I really can't help!
translator_note: Shinpachi says the Dragon Tama rumor makes him even less willing to help. Fixed-slot wording.

english: I'll get seven for Otsu first!
translator_note: Shinpachi plans to collect seven Dragon Tama for Otsu before Gintoki. Fixed-slot wording.

english: Any wish, right?\fMy fan club standing would soar...
translator_note: Shinpachi imagines how presenting the wish-granting orbs to Otsu would raise his standing as fan club captain. Both original pages kept.

english: No means no!\fGo find your own orbs!
Nice? You?
A duel?
Fine, but!\fNo rookie's beating me!
Gah! I lost to a nobody like Shinpachi!
translator_note: Shinpachi rumor follow-up or alternate duel loss.

english: A coup?!
No way! Who'd allow it?!
Shut up! If you star, I quit!
Yep! Show over! Game over!
Who cares? My rules!\nGame over!
Gin Tama's brutal!\fKeep playing? Start over! Dismissed!
So pushy.
Give up. Watch reruns.
Talk away.
You lost! I'm the new hero!\fHeroes can't lose\nto sidekicks!
Shin Tama now!
translator_note: Shinpachi renames the title Shin Tama, replacing Gin with Shin. Fixed-slot title joke.

english: Give up!
Quit?!
Selfish much? Think of the players!
Is this okay...?
Ha! A deal's a deal!
translator_note: After the Shinpachi duel. Dragon Tama remains distinct from Gin Tama.

english: Think of it...
Seven Dragon Tama grant any wish!\fWish for riches!\fThen spoil Otsu!
Money talks!\fGet rich. Otsu will notice!
Good man!
translator_note: Shinpachi agrees to help; Kagura sees through Gintoki.

english: Hush, kid. Not now.
What?
About Dragon Tama?!
Say it.
Rare orbs?!
Let's go later!\fNice work! Well connected!
You've grown!\fNearly there!
So are you.
Perm-head'll hog all seven!
That far?
I lost
I lost... to a rookie like Gin!
Huh?
R-right! That could work!
Let's do it, Gin!\nTogether, we'll get all seven\nDragon Balls!
Yes, Gin!\nFor a brighter future,\nlet's give it our all!
Oh, right, Gin!\fWhile collecting Gin Tama,\nI heard something interesting...
A fellow fan club member told me.
translator_note: Shinpachi heard the story from another fan club member. Source checked locally; wording shortened to the original fixed slot.

english: I don't know if it's true, but...
Someone saw a guy with a rare\nGin Tama near the [blue]Forest Trail[/color]...
See? Curious, right?
I'm not the captain for nothing!
What?! Found food?!\fGrab it if it's not rotten!
Huh? It's just\na middle-aged guy\nsweeping his doorstep.
Oh! Hasegawa!\fStill miserable, huh?
You're the one who needs help!
Easy! Fighting makes you hungry!\fSeen this before?
Got orbs?\fLet's duel!
Wake up!
That guy! Know his face?
Really, Hasegawa?\fVolunteers need time and money.\fYou can hardly afford that...
Gin Tama reflects life.
How many this month?
translator_note: Hijikata route introduction.

english: This is a safety problem.
Gin Tama trouble's on the rise.\fJoui rebels could misuse them too.
No! You know them!\fGin Tama...
Thieves?
Be clear! Be accurate!
That thing causing a fuss...
I'm not up on the latest fads...
Not much I could do.\fThat thing again...
Gin Tama dispute.\f\"Mine!\" \"Mine!\"\f\"Give!\" \"No!\"\fLike that.
One guy's head got smashed.\fCan't ignore bloodshed.\fGrilling the thug.
